parameters.voice_description: A native Korean woman in her twenties with a bright, fresh and naturally smiling voice. Clear, lightly sparkling upper-mid pitch with a full, smooth vocal body. She sounds like an engaging real person sharing something she likes. Lively varied conversational intonation, easy forward momentum and light buoyant sentence endings. Intimate, clean high-fidelity studio microphone sound.
